description: The royal assembly hall of Hastinapura. Interior. The stage for the Game of Dice and the Humiliation of Draupadi. No combat grid — purely a backdrop for VN scenes. The space is oppressive: a grand court designed to make outsiders feel small.

vn_backdrop_notes.lighting: Warm torch-lit interior. Oppressive heat implied by color palette (#4A235A, #900C3F, #FFC300 per KAURAVA aesthetics).
vn_backdrop_notes.layout_description: A long rectangular hall. Dhritarashtra sits on the throne (north). Dice table center. Draupadi's quarters (east, off-screen). Crowds line the walls.
interactive_elements: Dice table — the focus of the gameplay mechanic (SACRIFICE directive: player must not refuse or interfere).
Draupadi's entry point — triggers the Disrobing dialogue sequence.
Vidura's corner — he speaks. Listening to his counsel is optional but raises Dharma slightly.
vn_backdrop_notes.note: This map serves as a stage only. It must be buildable as a rich parallax background in VNScene.js, not TacticalScene.js.
